preconditions.description: The number of nodes n is between 1 and 200000 inclusive.
The number of queries m is between 1 and 200000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 1000 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each initial value a_i of the nodes is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v_i <= n and 1 <= u_i <= n for v_i, u_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two nodes between 1 and n inclusive.
The number of edges is exactly n - 1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(query[0] in {1, 2} for query in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query is of type 1 or 2.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for _, x, *_ in queries)
preconditions.description: Each node x in the queries is between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= val <= 1000 for query in queries if query[0] == 1 for _, _, val in [query])
preconditions.description: Each value val in type 1 queries is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(output, str) for output in outputs)

postconditions.description: Each output string is a digit.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(output) <= 2000 for output in outputs)
postconditions.description: Each output value is between 1 and 2000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: len(outputs) == sum(1 for query in queries if query[0] == 2)
postconditions.description: The number of outputs matches the number of type 2 queries.
